reviews.text: Andrew did a fantastic job replacing rotten siding, sheathing and framing that the masons uncovered when demoing my front stoop.  I was in a bit of an emergency and he was there the next day.  I like that he explained in detail what needed to be done and even took extra measures to ensure the damage didn't happen again in the future.  An exceptional contractor with a keen attention to detail, honest, communicative, and affordable.  I'll be reaching out the next time I need any work done on the house. Thanks again!

facts.about_text: At Houser Construction Company, we are dedicated to turning your vision into reality. With over 6 years of experience, we have built a reputation for delivering high-quality residential and commercial construction projects. Our team of skilled professionals specializes in everything from bathroom renovations to large scale additions and alterations.
